name: ollama-local
_comment: Benchmarks every model installed in your local Ollama (auto-discovered via /api/tags). Edit 'include' to restrict, e.g. ["qwen2.5-coder", "llama3.1"]. Set rate_usd_per_hour to your own GPU-hour cost to get a monetary cost; leave null to show cost as N/A. Energy is measured with nvidia-smi when an NVIDIA GPU is present.

infrastructure.rate_source: Not set — edit config/run.ollama.json (e.g. an amortised GPU-hour cost or a cloud reference price) to compute monetary cost.
